"use client";

import { Button } from "@/components/rendyn-libraries/shadcn/ui/button"
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyContent,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/rendyn-libraries/shadcn/upstream/registry/new-york-v4/ui/empty"
import { Spinner } from "@/components/rendyn-libraries/shadcn/upstream/registry/new-york-v4/ui/spinner"

export default function SpinnerEmpty() {
  return (
    <Empty className="w-full">
      <EmptyHeader>
        <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
          <Spinner />
        </EmptyMedia>
        <EmptyTitle>Processing your request</EmptyTitle>
        <EmptyDescription>
          Please wait while we process your request. Do not refresh the page.
        </EmptyDescription>
      </EmptyHeader>
      <EmptyContent>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
          Cancel
        </Button>
      </EmptyContent>
    </Empty>
  )
}

# shadcn/ui spinner

10 published shadcn/ui spinner examples with complete pinned source and MIT attribution.

## Installation

- Copyable component source and official examples, not a dependency on a hosted registry.
- Use Tailwind CSS 4 and configure the standard shadcn semantic colour tokens (background, foreground, primary, border, input, ring, muted and accent).

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
